UK regulator bonus (0-15): +15 for FCA/HMRC/NCA/SFO/PSR/ICO/TPR. Impact tier (0-10): enforcement/fine=10, guidance=6, consultation=3. Source trust (0-10): official regulator RSS=10, scrape=7, news=4.
